content: Third-party ad scripts are the most common cause of Core Web Vitals regressions on otherwise-optimized Next.js sites -- they compete for bandwidth/CPU and delay hero content. Fix: use next/script with strategy=afterInteractive for ad scripts (never beforeInteractive, which is reserved for critical scripts). Reserve fixed-size containers (min-height / aspect-ratio) for ad slots so injected creatives don't cause CLS -- late-loading unsized ad banners are the top CLS culprit.
